items.problem: The scaffold, bootstrap, and bootstrap self-check were launched concurrently, causing Target not found and a false self-check.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turn 1: Test-Path returned False and bootstrap threw Target not found before dotnet new completed.
items.covered_clearly_at: SKILL.md Step 0 numbers the scaffold, bootstrap, and self-check as commands 1, 2, and 3; it says not to proceed unless command 3 returns True.
items.why_no_skill_change: The dependency order and stop condition are already explicit and prominent.

items.problem: The agent introduced inconsistent namespaces across MainPage, SampleConfiguration, XAML x:Class, and MainWindow, causing CS0246/WMC0001/WMC9999.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turns 19-30: successive edits moved only part of the related type set before later reconciling all references.
items.covered_clearly_at: SKILL.md Critical Rules / Fidelity says to copy XAML verbatim then transform while preserving names and event handlers; Step 1 assigns file-level completion rather than partial cross-file rewrites.
items.why_no_skill_change: The failures came from an inconsistent intermediate edit, not an undocumented UWP-to-WinUI API difference.

items.problem: The agent added required members to types activated by generated XAML code, causing CS9035.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turns 23 and 30-31: required was agent-authored, XamlTypeInfo.g.cs failed, and initialized properties fixed it.
items.covered_clearly_at: SKILL.md Step 3 requires fixing the first build error in a tight loop and preserving source behavior rather than redesigning model construction.
items.why_no_skill_change: The source did not require this refactor; a rerun that avoids speculative required-member changes would not hit the error.

items.problem: Build, launch, and validation ran concurrently against the same obj/bin tree, producing transient CS2001 missing generated-file errors.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turn 42 launched all three commands together; build output reported missing *.g.i.cs while the validator's later rebuild succeeded.
items.covered_clearly_at: SKILL.md Step 3 explicitly defines the loop as build, then fix, then launch, then repeat; Step 4 runs validation only after migration work is complete.
items.why_no_skill_change: The process order is already explicit; dependent build and launch operations should not have been parallelized.
